content: Yesus Nhokar doini hegana-kawnu la Gerasa
Yesus Nora maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye'a re rhopal pa rodi liarni la' danau Galilea walli, la'a riy Gerasa genni-tienni.
La'pa Yesus Nerun la keranni, dewade muanke' maka yatni-rha'ani ha rhu'ru ralma ida nlergot la hu'ula-liena la'a tniamin mat geni ralamni pa nma nler temna.
Riy de nhol lia hu'ula-liena mak kden la tniamin mat geni ralamni, ne riy id ho'mana edon narur pia nwut niana, rnairi wutwutu mnotna ho'mana ta'eni.
Yoma nhi'inde riy e rwutu-rkohog e limni-lakni, de rnairia wutwutu mnotna, mere na'ed lia inonni pa nwuhi eti-lahwa re la'a limni, me nweyata ranti la'a lakni. Riy id mana ta'en niana ntoran nana.
Lelera-melmel de, nden to'ola tniamin mat geni ralamni me la'a wo'ora-kawru pa nhaunu-nhaunu me nal watu na ntu'tu nlakwehi tio' inonni.
La'pa namkek nana Yesus Nwatiawua oliet pa Nmai wia dewade nawlar pia la nwatroma. Noka nwaltiora-nwaltieman la Yesus gaini ralamni.

Yesus Nakot la Niwra: “Hega'nu ne! Mhuargot la riy di ralamni!” Dewade riy de nhaunu-nhaunu pa niwra: “Yesus ee! O' de Uplerlawna mak kden la tutullu-lolo'oni A'nani O'a! Hota Omhi' nana a'g emkameni ee! Omliokar pa mpuet la Uplerlawna nanni totpena yana Mukmua a'u.”
Noma Yesus Natiana riy de Niwra: “O nanmu he'a?” Noma riy de nwalolla niwra: “A na'nu Legion yoma am di de yatni-rha'ani liawanni. (Nanni de nnia'eratni keki-rautu woka liawanni).
Noma nwakwak rer lia Yesus totpena Yesus yana Nhokar gota hare pa rhoitio'or doini la lowan de.
La' hande de e rehgorgorga gen miaka wawi wok lawna e rwayowar pa rahak pa ra'ana-remun la wo'ora hananni.
Noma yatni-rha'ani re rwak lilili-mamuau lia Yesus totpena Nhopan nekpa irler la wawi re inonni ralamni.

Yesus Nwayowa, dewade rlergot la riy de inonni, pa rla' rhu'ru ralma wawi re, na'nama honona re rawlar pia rla rlererun la weran teti pa ema rwuwul wenwenna la' danau de ralamni. Wawi honona re la'pa edon nhal de riwnu woru.
Nhor nioka mak khuri-kwa'ana wawi re rawlar pia rla rod kiota la'a ir letni me gen miaka rehgorgoru. Noma riy rlergot pa rma rpoi-rkeka (ramkeka) hya' maka ha rakota re.

Riy rawok la Yesus onni pa ramkek memna riy maka yatni-rha'ani rlergot la de, e namtatan reria, nnairi oleka pola-raini me wniaror samomuou ed olek la ihranu ralamni. Noma riy honona re ramta'at wenna.
Riy mak kden hande maka ramkek oleka Yesus Nhokar doinia yatni-rha'ani re, rwahaur nohor hadel la'a riy mak kmai re, ne rwahaur nohor walia wawi re.
Nhor na'nama riy mak kden hande rwak lilili-mamuau pua Yesus yan memmemna Nalo'on la' gen die ne plet pa Nwaran nek wa.
La'pa Yesus Nha'at owa'an la' puou ralamni de, riy mak yatni-rha'ani re ha rlergot la de, nwak la Yesus totpena nlernohor rer wialia Yesus.

Mere Yesus Nahmena, pa Nakot la Niwra: “Samomuounu de muwal lia genmu-tienmu, me mukot nohora Orgahi-Orha'a ralam kalwiedni tiy o'a, me la'a hare honona mak samomomuou memna maka Enhi'a-nyapi la o'a.”
Dewade riy de nla'awa la'pa nakot nohora hare honona la mak kdena Dekapolis la'a hya'a maka Yesus ha Nhi'a la e'a. Ne riy honona mak katlin nan de rwer rer wiawni.
Yesus Nhi' kalwieda Yairus a'nani me patke'a maka khur riara
Noma Yesus Nodi puou pa Nlereti owa'an la danau walli, dewade riy rahu lidna-lidan pa rmai pa rpe'pa reri E'a la gera aratni.
Noma edon nalo'on wali ne Yairus makhi' o'tani la'a gen maka Yahudi re rhi' kreini-iskolli de nmai wia. La'pa namkek nana Yesus dewade nwaltior la Yesus nayanni
na'nama nwak lilili-mamuau lia Yesus, niwra: “Tuna, a a'nu patke'a namehra pa trema-trema hota nmat wia. Awuak de, Mtiulan pa Mlia Mtieman la e'a totpena nkalwied owa'ana, totpa yana nmati.”
Noka Yesus Nor riy de pa rla'awa. Riy rahu lidna-tauru rlernohora pa idma rde'da la'a rde'da mai ida.
La' riy rahu re, de patke' mak khur riara la'a anni termida wehrani woru, e nor wali.

La'pa tilti'ila-walwial tiarga la yakrui-yagapnu la mak katu kakrui-kagapnu (dokter) pa nareiniande nahor dioini momuoga re'eni-tniarnu pa npair la makakrui-kagapnu, mere mehrani de edon nkalwied eti, mere yeher to' pa na'itar la.
Natlin oleka hya'a mak Yesus Nhi'a, noma nwakriania Yesus la mutu letgarni. Ndella Yesus to'orni na'nama nteman la Yesus raini plalahwani.
Yoma nwaror la ralamni: “Hornama atieman to'ola raini plalahwani de, de hota akalwied wa.”
La'pa mtatande nekpa rarni mak kawdiadia'i de nkeran wa, ne nat niohor memna inonni nkalwied wa.
Mtatande nekpa Yesus Na'eram nana de rurni-laini nlergota la inonni, noka Nheri gaini pa Namkek la riy rahu re, na'nama Natiana re: “He' ed maka kteman la A rainu?”
Maka ha Nwatutu-nwaye'a re rwahla: “Omumkeka de riy rahu ri rpakdie'da la'a O hermu-gaimu, mere Mutian owa'ana he' ed mak kteman la O rayanmu?!”
Noka Namkek la'a-Namkek mai totpena Nahaka he' ed maka khi' nana hihi'a-yapyap di.
Patke' de namta'ata pa nruru yoma nat niohora hya' ed maka khi' olek la inonni, dewade nla nwaltiora-nwaltiemna la Yesus gaini ralamni na'nama nakota plele'er nohora hya'a maka nhi' oleka wa.
Noma Yesus Nakot la Niwra: “O pesiaymu e narur mai A'u ina pa mkialwied wa! Mlia'awa pa mmuori-mdiar lia kalwiedni-paitiotni.”
La'pa Yesus enaltiertier mia'ta de dewade riy dom rwatiawu Yairus romni pa rmai rakot la Yairus de niwra: “Tuna, a'namu nmati olekwa pa yana mpuaka Tungkur die pa nla'a o rommu nayanni.”
Mere Yesus edonna nhe'du nohora lirni re mere Nakot la Yairus Niwra: “Yan mumta'ata. Mpuesiay niek wa.”
Noma Yesus edonna Nhur niohora riy id wali pa Nora talla, atiaru Petrus, Yakowsi nor wutga hyalli Yohansi.
La'pa rte'ela Yairus romni, ramkek nan de riy rahu mak kokna-krarnia. Rko'a-rkakur nohora mat die.
Noma Yesus Nla'awa rialam pa Nakot la re: “Nihya'pa mimkiokna-mriarni mkio'a-mkiakru?! Hararar de edonna nmati, hade e nanin to'a.”

La'pa ratlin nana Yesus lirni de, noma honona riarin taru la yamalli. Noma Nhokar doin hare honona, na'nama Nod hararar de inni-amni ror wutga Petrus, Yakowsi me Yohansi pa ror rewre'wa rla'awa la hararar de genni la'a rialma,
na'nama Ntorreria hararar de limni na'nama Nakot la Niwra: “Talita kum”, nnia'eratni de: “Ina, A'ukot tiy o' de, mumat wa!”
Mtatande nekpa hararar de naprir pia nala'awa. Hararar de umurnu termida wehrani woru olek wa. Riy mak kden la hande rwer rer wiawni la'a hihi'-yapyap die.
Mere Yesus Nlaran pa yan memmemna rakota hadella hehe'a. Na'nama Yesus Nhopan pa ralla harar de pa na'ana.
